segments.ja352:1.1: Kiṃ nu santaramānova, lāyitvā haritaṃ tiṇaṃ;
segments.ja352:2.1: Na hi annena pānena, mato goṇo samuṭṭhahe;
segments.ja352:2.3: Tvañca tucchaṃ vilapasi, yathā taṃ dummatī tathā.
segments.ja352:3.1: Tatheva tiṭṭhati sīsaṃ, hatthapādā ca vāladhi;
segments.ja352:3.3: Sotā tatheva tiṭṭhanti [so tāta tatheva tiṭṭhati (ka.)], maññe goṇo samuṭṭhahe.
segments.ja352:4.1: Nevayyakassa sīsañca [sīsaṃ vā (sī. syā. pī.)], hatthapādā ca dissare;
segments.ja352:5.1: Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ, ghatasittaṃva pāvakaṃ;
segments.ja352:5.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ [osiñci (ka.)], sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.ja352:6.1: Abbahī [abbūḷhaṃ (sī. syā.), abbhūḷhaṃ (ka.)] vata me sallaṃ, yamāsi hadayassitaṃ [sokaṃ hadayanissitaṃ (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja352:6.3: Yo me sokaparetassa, pitu sokaṃ apānudi.
segments.ja352:7.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna māṇava.
segments.ja352:8.1: Evaṃ karonti sappaññā, ye honti anukampakā;
